prompt_template: Create an object that I can use for a videogame sprite, in the style of Studio Ghibli, soft hand-painted cel shading, cozy warm palette. Draw exactly one object, centered and filling most of the frame: {description} Create a full white background so the object can be easily cut out - no drop shadow, no ground plane, no text, no watermark.

objects.prompt: A police handheld walkie-talkie radio with a small antenna and worn buttons.
A formal leather-bound guest sign-in registry book, open on a small stand, a pen resting on the page.
An ornate empty brass birdcage on a tall stand, its little door hanging open with a snapped latch, a few stray feathers settled at the bottom.
A small hidden wireless speaker with a thin audio cable trailing from it.
A single empty canvas gardening work glove, cream fabric with a ribbed cuff, smudged with dark soil, limp and slightly crumpled with deflated floppy fingers, clearly no hand inside it.
A soft yellow lemon-oil polishing cloth draped neatly over a short brass rail.
A professional film documentary camera on a tripod with a glowing red recording light.
A small open booklet of taught parrot phrases, one handwritten line crossed out in pen.
A clipboard holding a crew delivery manifest sheet with handwritten lines and a scrawled signature.
A collected room-service dinner tray with scraped-clean soup bowls and silverware squared away neatly.
An elegant handwritten note on cream stationery.
An open premium product box for luxury noise-canceling headphones, with tissue paper and a receipt visible.
An audio mixing board sound desk covered in knobs and faders, one cable running off the back.
A stack of recording session log pages covered in angry handwriting, the last sheet torn.
A director's printed shot list on a clipboard, one line crossed out in red pen.
A handwritten note held by a small round fridge magnet at its top edge, with an angry little skull doodle on it.
A large steaming paella pan full of colorful saffron rice and seafood.
A cute ceramic treat jar with a handwritten 'FOR THE CAT' label.
A wooden poultry delivery crate with a small bin of plain little feathers beside it.
A kitchen duty roster sheet with a pushpin through one corner, slightly curling paper with a handwritten list of times.
A pair of heavy iron pruning shears with slightly bent blade tips.
Two massive black sound-proof acoustic road cases with heavy latches, stacked, a gray tarp thrown halfway over them in a hurry.
A weathered stone garden bird bath with a few bright red and blue feathers floating on the water.
A smartphone held upright showing a poolside selfie on its screen, a blurry figure with dark cases visible in the photo's background.
A printed film production schedule sheet on a clipboard with listed times.
SKIPPED - the glittering pool surface is painted into the room background, not a cutout sprite (see sprite_prompts.txt).
